title: Correct pre-read tenant denial and durable provider invocation claim
summary: Resolved the two counterexamples identified in parent PR #6144: (1) Enforced signed JWT tenant presence validation strictly BEFORE invoking persistent_owner.get in retry_trade_reflection and list_trade_reflections, returning 403 on missing tenant claims with 0 owner reads and 0 telemetry/provider effects. (2) Atomically persisted full content and tenant-bound invocation claims in the existing Persona metadata CAS/idempotency store before invoking telemetry fetcher or OpenClaw reflection provider. Concurrent same-key requests perform exactly one provider call and no duplicate telemetry fetches, returning 409 in-flight conflict or stable completed receipts. On provider/telemetry failure, in-flight claims are safely cleaned up with zero inappropriate side-effects. All 5 coordinator direct-owner counterexamples in test_trade_journal_direct_owner_contract.py pass. Net production lines diff is +9 (budget 12).

ac5_counterexamples_resolved.evidence: Fixed direct-owner counterexample failures: missing-tenant returns 403 with reads=0 fetch=0 provider=0; concurrent same-key requests perform exactly 1 provider call and 1 telemetry fetch.

ac6_preread_tenant_denial.evidence: In write_owner.py retry_trade_reflection and list_trade_reflections, authority.tenant_id is verified immediately after JWT authentication and before persistent_owner.get(persona_id). Anonymous requests return 401 and signed tenantless requests return 403 with zero owner reads.

ac7_durable_atomic_claim_guard.evidence: Invocation claim atomically persisted into persona.metadata.trade_reflection_idempotency via try_metadata_cas before active_telemetry_fetcher and provider.reflect. Concurrent same-key requests detect the in-flight claim and return 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT without duplicate provider calls or fetches. Completed responses update the claim with durable receipts. Failure after claim reverts in-flight metadata with zero residual effects.

ac8_contract_counterexamples_and_regress.evidence: test_trade_journal_direct_owner_contract.py ran 5/5 passed. Existing regressions in services/persona/test_trade_reflection_owner.py (10/10 passed) and services/control-plane/bff/test_ptj_004_trade_journal.py (10/10 passed) all pass (25 total tests passing).

ac9_net_prod_line_budget.evidence: Net production change in services/persona/write_owner.py is +55/-46 = +9 net lines, strictly satisfying the 12 line net production budget for corrective change_class.
